Results.ReviewText: I bought my grill on 9/24/20 from Ace Hardware and it was delivered on 10/2/20.  It came fully assembled.  I had to pay an extra $20 for delivery, but it was no big deal.  I have been using Weber gas grills for 33 yrs., and this is my 3rd grill, so you know the reliability.  I hope the 10 yr. warranty expires before I do.  I have cooked on the grill several times, but today was fantastic.  I barbequed 10 Chicken thighs.  I set the temperature on low because   I like to cook at about 350 degrees until the internal temperature reaches 155 degrees.  That way the chicken is both done and juicy.   I have a separate wireless meat thermometer.  I chicken came out fantastic.  There were no flareups, the chicken did not stick to the grill and cleaning the grill grates was the easiest I have ever had.  I could not be more pleased.  Don't even consider another grill.  You will not be disappointed with this grill.
Results.Title: Fantastic Grill

Results.ReviewText:
This is my third Spirit LP grill and, like the previous two, it is an outstanding grill.  The assembly instructions are clear and "easy" to follow.  This grill has been used on salmon filets, steaks, and a whole chicken with the outstanding results I have grown used to for over 20 years.  

During the assembly  I did have an issue with installing the fuel gauge on step 40 where the right side table "interfered" with installing the fuel gauge.  It would have been so much easier install the fuel gauge before putting on the side table.  

A second issue that I encountered had to do with receiving a unit with a dented grill cover that was unfortunatly discovered after I had removed and verified I had all 150 parts. The solution was to repack everything and return it to Home Depot for a replacement.  That was no small task as the package is designed to minimize any unused space and repackaging it was like a huge 3-D puzzle which I failed miserably on.  Fortunately, Home Depot was OK with my best effort and the stack of parts that would not fit.  What would have helped was an exploded view of the packing to help with putting all the parts back in the box.
